desc: Client delivery with written milestone sign-offs, about 25 steps, 3-6 months.

steps.t: Align with sponsor: objectives, decision makers, constraints
steps.n: Confirm who signs off and which of scope, time, cost is fixed.

steps.t: Write scope statement and out-of-scope list
Define acceptance criteria for every deliverable
Estimate as a range with declared buffer
steps.n: Give best, likely and worst case in writing; declare the 20-30% buffer.

steps.t: Risk register v1 and communication plan

steps.g: no build work starts until the charter is signed by both sides

steps.t: Set up change log and blockers log

steps.n: Use the status entry format; log later reports in the project context.

steps.t: Demo to sponsor after each iteration
Build the core flow on staging

steps.n: Objectives still valid? Scope crept? Timeline and budget realistic? Risks materialised? Stakeholders aligned? Team sustainable?

steps.t: Core features working on staging; scope freeze

steps.n: Book in advance; findings feed the risk register.

steps.t: Acceptance review / UAT with the people who will use it

steps.g: requires the independent review and UAT to have passed

steps.t: Codify what worked into the knowledge base

name: client-delivery
